A mailto link is extracted into metadata.links when extract_metadata is true

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");

    const _result_json = try html_to_markdown_rs.convert("<p>Contact <a href=\"mailto:hello@example.com\">us</a> directly.</p>", "{\"extract_metadata\":true}");
```
